title: A negative result on shrinkage estimators in small-N replication
abstract: We attempt to replicate the shrinkage-estimator results of [Brown 2021] under small-N conditions and report a negative finding. Our analysis identifies two likely sources of the original effect: data leakage in the holdout split and a misspecified prior. We release replication code and a corrected reanalysis.

claims.statement: Brown 2021's reported shrinkage gains do not survive a leak-free reanalysis.
The misspecified prior accounts for ~60% of the reported effect size.
